weeks.name: Mesh
weeks.text:
🏈 **Football 101: Mesh**

Two receivers run shallow crossing routes from opposite sides & cross so close they almost slap hands about 5 yards downfield

Against man coverage the defenders chasing them run right into each other, so one of the crossers comes out a step free & that's all the QB needs

Against zone they just sit down in the open windows

This one has BYU roots too, it's an Air Raid staple that came out of LaVell Edwards' offenses

Next time you're watching, look for two receivers crossing underneath right in front of the linebackers 👀

Full breakdown in Football 101 Essentials, free for every member

https://cougconnect.com/courses/football-101-essentials/lessons/essentials-mesh/

weeks.name: Cover 3
weeks.text:
🏈 **Football 101: Cover 3**

Three defenders split the deep field into thirds, the two corners & the free safety

Four more cover zones underneath, so a safety can drop down & add an extra guy against the run

That's why so many teams live in it, it's safe deep & still sound vs the run

The way to beat it is to put two receivers on that one middle safety, like four verticals running both seams

Next time you're watching, look for one deep safety & the corners backpedaling at the snap 👀

Full breakdown in Football 101 Essentials, free for every member

https://cougconnect.com/courses/football-101-essentials/lessons/essentials-cover-3/

weeks.name: Zone read
weeks.text:
🏈 **Football 101: Zone read**

It's inside zone, except the line leaves the backside defensive end unblocked on purpose

The QB puts the ball in the back's belly & reads that end

If he stays home, hand it off. If he crashes down on the back, pull it & keep it where he just left

Reading a guy instead of blocking him basically gives the offense an extra blocker

Defenses counter w/ a "scrape exchange", the end takes the back & a linebacker loops outside for the QB

Next time you're watching, watch the backside end instead of the ball. Whatever he does, the ball goes the other way 👀

Full breakdown in Football 101 Essentials, free for every member

https://cougconnect.com/courses/football-101-essentials/lessons/essentials-zone-read/

weeks.name: E-T twist ("EXIT")
weeks.text:
🏈 **Football 101: The EXIT stunt**

This one's up front. The defensive end sells a speed rush for two steps, then cuts hard inside through the guard

The tackle waits until the end goes past him, then loops around the outside & takes over contain

It punishes an offensive tackle who sets too wide to stop the speed rush, the inside opens up & then the looper comes around where the end used to be

The fix is the guard staying tight to his tackle & the line passing the end inside, then kicking back out to the looper

Next time you're watching, look for a defensive end who takes two steps upfield & then suddenly cuts inside 👀

Full breakdown in Football 101 Essentials, free for every member

https://cougconnect.com/courses/football-101-essentials/lessons/essentials-stunt-exit/

weeks.name: Four verticals
weeks.text:
🏈 **Football 101: Four verticals**

Four receivers run straight downfield

The outside guys run go routes a couple yards inside the sideline & the slots run the seams

One deep safety can't cover both seams, so one of them has to come open

The QB just reads that middle safety & throws to whichever seam he doesn't take

Defenses answer w/ two deep safeties to match the seams, or by getting pressure before the routes develop

Next time you're watching, watch the middle safety. When he picks a side, the ball goes to the other 👀

Full breakdown in Football 101 Essentials, free for every member

https://cougconnect.com/courses/football-101-essentials/lessons/essentials-four-verticals/

weeks.name: Cover 2
weeks.text:
🏈 **Football 101: Cover 2**

Two safeties split the deep field in half & five defenders cover zones underneath

The corners play short, jam the outside receiver & sit on the flat around 5 yards

It's tough on quick outside throws & keeps two safeties over the top to limit big plays

The soft spots are behind the squatting corner, the deep middle between the safeties & the sideline hole between the corner & safety

Next time you're watching, look for corners playing tight & not bailing at the snap, w/ both safeties deep 👀

Full breakdown in Football 101 Essentials, free for every member

https://cougconnect.com/courses/football-101-essentials/lessons/essentials-cover-2/

weeks.name: Power
weeks.text:
🏈 **Football 101: Power**

A gap run that puts more blockers than defenders right at the hole

The playside linemen block down, an H-back or fullback kicks out the end & the backside guard pulls through the hole to lead for the back

That pulling guard shows up where the defense didn't expect a blocker

Defenses fight it by spilling the kick-out so the run bounces outside, or by blitzing the gap before the puller gets there

Next time you're watching, find the pulling guard. He's taking you to the hole 👀

Full breakdown is in our Run Game course, included w/ Silver & Gold

https://cougconnect.com/courses/football-101-run-game/

weeks.name: Smash
weeks.text:
🏈 **Football 101: Smash**

The outside receiver runs a short hitch & the slot runs a corner route right over the top of him

It's built to beat Cover 2, where one corner has to choose

The QB reads that corner. If he squats on the hitch, throw the corner route over him. If he sinks, throw the hitch

In Cover 2 the corner has the flat & the safety is deep, so the corner route lands right between them

Teams answer w/ quarters coverage, where the corner can sink deep

Next time you're watching, watch the corner. Squat or sink? 👀

Full breakdown in Football 101 Essentials, free for every member

https://cougconnect.com/courses/football-101-essentials/lessons/essentials-smash/
